Initial inventory failure prevents creation; create timeout with already-visible allocation is recoverable; boot/bootstatus errors enter root finalization.
Independent cleanup attempts retain errors while trying shutdown, exact delete, absence/preexisting UUID checks and bounded process scan.

Root finalizer defers repeat INT/TERM, runs Gradle stop, simulator cleanup, owned-worker cleanup, evidence capture, precise generated-dir cleanup and final source/control identity.
